```{r setup}
myPath <- "path_to_github" #ADD PATH TO GITHUB FOLDER

#load functions
source(paste0(myPath, "/functions/downstreamAnalysisFunctions.R"))

# import metadata
metadata_all<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/metadata.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# read in relevant files
k4me3_peaks_counts_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/correctedCounts/K4me3/k4me3_k4Peaks_correctedCounts.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k4me3_meta<-metadata_all[rownames(metadata_all) %in% colnames(k4me3_peaks_counts_corrected),]

k4me3_peakList<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/consensusPeaks/H3K4me3_consensusPeakset_SAF.txt'), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)
annoFile<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/annotations/tss1000_condensed_SAF.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header=TRUE)

#only want the protein coding genes
annoFile_pcg<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/annotations/pcgSAF.txt"), check.names=FALSE,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header=TRUE)
annoFile<-annoFile[annoFile$Gene%in% annoFile_pcg$GeneID,]

k4me3_peakListAnno<-annotatePeakFile(k4me3_peakList, annoFile)
k4me3_peakListAnnoX<-k4me3_peakListAnno[k4me3_peakListAnno$Chr=="chrX",]

k4me3_k4Peaklm_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/K4me3/k4me3_k4me3Peaks_lm_corrected.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

```

# Track Plotting

```{r H3K4me3 Tracks}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(biomaRt)) #please note, biomaRt is no longer supported by ensembl.
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(trackDJ))
trackFiles<-c("7241_XY_H3K4me3.bw","5755_XY_H3K4me3.bw","7229_XY_H3K4me3.bw", "6029_XX_H3K4me3.bw" ,"7247_XX_H3K4me3.bw","7249_XX_H3K4me3.bw","7242_XXXXY_H3K4me3.bw", "7324_XXXXY_H3K4me3.bw", "7346_XXXXY_H3K4me3.bw") # replace with paths to bigwig files
trackNames<-c("XY_1","XY_2","XY_3","XX_1","XX_2","XX_3","XXXXY_1", "XXXXY_2","XXXXY_3")
```

# Linear modeling graphs 

```{r linearModelingPlots}

# Figure 2B: PRPS2
PRPS2_k4me3_peaks<-plotgene('Peak_41652', 'X', metaFile,k4me3_peaks_counts_corrected, 'H3K4me3',-2,1000, 'black' )
PRPS2_k4me3_peaks_line<-addLineInfo('Peak_41652',k4me3_k4Peaklm_corrected, PRPS2_k4me3_peaks )
print(PRPS2_k4me3_peaks_line)

# Figure 2D: KDM6A

# Figure 2F: XIST

print(XIST_k4me3_peaks_line)
```

# Compare Xi-silent vs Xi-expressed genes on Xa and Xi
```{r silVexp}

k4me3_k4Peaklm_corrected_X<-k4me3_k4Peaklm_corrected[rownames(k4me3_k4Peaklm_corrected) %in% k4me3_peakListAnnoX$PeakID,]
k4me3_peakLm_X$PeakID<-rownames(k4me3_peakLm_X)

## Assign peaks to genes
k4me3_peakLm_X<-peakGeneMatch(k4me3_peakLm_X, k4me3_peakListAnnoX)

## Add XCI status
k4me3_peakLm_X<-expStatus(k4me3_peakLm_X)

## For genes with multiple promoter peaks, take the highest one
k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS<-maxTSS(k4me3_peakLm_X)
k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS$xciStatus<-factor(k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS$xciStatus, levels=c("Xi-silent", "Xi-expressed", "not expressed", "XIST", "no XCI call"))
xaXicolorList_k4<-c("Xa"="lightgreen", "Xi"="darkgreen")


# Figure 2H: boxplot
k4Peaks_xa_xi_box<-formatPlot(xa_xi_box(k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS,"LCL")+scale_fill_manual(values=xaXicolorList_k4)+xlab("XCI Status")+ylab("H3K4me3 Level \n (Normalized counts)"))+theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# Figure 2I: Xa v Xi scatterplot
k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS$label<-NA
k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS$label[k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS$Gene %in% c("PRPS2", "KDM6A", "NAP1L3", "XIST")]<-k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS[k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS$Gene %in% c("PRPS2", "KDM6A", "NAP1L3", "XIST"),]$Gene
xcicolorList_k4<-c("Xi-silent"="yellowgreen", "Xi-expressed"="green4", "XIST"="black", "not expressed"="grey60")

k4Peaks_xa_xi_scatter<-formatPlot(ggplot(data=k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS[k4me3_peakLm_X_maxTSS$xciStatus != "no XCI call",], mapping=aes(x=intercept_his, y=x_his_coeff, color=xciStatus, label=label))+
                                    geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.7)+scale_color_manual(values=xcicolorList_k4)+theme_classic()+
                                    xlim(-15,300)+ylim(-15,300)+xlab("H3K4me3 Level on Xa")+ylab("H3K4me3 Level on Xi")+
                                    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
                                    geom_label_repel(alpha=0.7))

# Figure 2J: deltaK4me3.x violin plot 
k4me3_peakLm_X_summed<-sumPeaksbyGene(k4me3_peakLm_X)
k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$deltak4me3.x<-k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff/k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his
k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$deltak4me3.x_err<-sqrt((((k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff)^2)/((k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his)^2))*(((k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff_err^2))/(k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff^2) +(k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his_err^2/k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his^2)))


xist_int<-k4me3_peakLm_X_summed[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$Gene=="XIST",]$intercept_his
xist_slope<-k4me3_peakLm_X_summed[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$Gene=="XIST",]$x_his_coeff

k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$deltak4me3.x[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$Gene=="XIST"]<-xist_slope/(xist_int+xist_slope)
k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$xciStatus<-factor(k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$xciStatus, levels=c("Xi-silent", "Xi-expressed", "not expressed", "XIST", "no XCI call"))
xcicolorList_k4<-c("Xi-silent"="yellowgreen", "Xi-expressed"="green4", "XIST"="black", "not expressed"="grey60")

dk4me3_peak_vio<-formatPlot(ggplot(data=k4me3_peakLm_X_summed[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$xciStatus != "no XCI call",], mapping=aes(x=xciStatus, y=deltak4me3.x, fill=xciStatus))+geom_violin(trim=FALSE)+geom_boxplot(width=0.03, fill="white", outlier.shape = NA)+
                              scale_fill_manual(values=xcicolorList_k4)+theme_classic()+scale_color_manual(values=xcicolorList_k4)+xlab("XCI Status"))+theme(aspect.ratio=1)

# Figure 2K: deltaK4me3.x vs deltaEx scatter plot

k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$label<-NA
k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$label[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$Gene %in% c("PRPS2", "KDM6A", "NAP1L3", "XIST")]<-k4me3_peakLm_X_summed[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$Gene %in% c("PRPS2", "KDM6A", "NAP1L3", "XIST"),]$Gene
k4me3_peakLm_X_summed_exp<-k4me3_peakLm_X_summed[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed$expStatus=="expressed",]

RegioncolorList_k4<-c("PAR1"="aquamarine3", "NPX"="green4", "PAR2"="grey60")

expVk4me3_scatter<-formatPlot(ggplot(data=k4me3_peakLm_X_summed_exp[k4me3_peakLm_X_summed_exp$xciStatus=="Xi-expressed",], mapping=aes(x=deltak4me3.x, y=deltaEx, label=label))+geom_point(size=4, alpha=0.7, aes(color=region))+
  scale_color_manual(values=RegioncolorList_k4)+theme_classic()+geom_smooth(method="lm", linetype="dashed", size=1, color="black")+geom_text_repel(aes(color=region))+
    xlab("deltaH3K4me3.x")+ylab("deltaEx"))+theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

```
